# Leone Consulting

> AI engineering, software development and data engineering consulting for SMEs, professionals and startups. Based in Lugano, Ticino, Switzerland. Bilingual site: Italian (default) and English (/en/).

Leone Consulting is a technical consultancy by Mario Leone: applied AI (MCP architectures, custom intelligent agents, open-source LLM fine-tuning and inference), custom software, data pipelines and dashboards, with security considered from the start. Every blog article cites its sources and states limitations explicitly.

## Main pages

- [Home — AI consulting for Swiss SMEs](https://leoneconsulting.dev/): services overview, packages, featured case studies
- [About](https://leoneconsulting.dev/about): who, method (analysis → design and development → validation and deployment), expertise areas
- [Portfolio](https://leoneconsulting.dev/portfolio): case studies with measurable outcomes
- [Packages](https://leoneconsulting.dev/pacchetti): tech audit, MVP sprint, data pipeline
- [AI consulting in Ticino](https://leoneconsulting.dev/consulenza-ai-ticino): geo-focused services page (Italian)
- [Guides](https://leoneconsulting.dev/guide): practical checklists from process to first test
- [Free async technical audit](https://leoneconsulting.dev/audit-asincrono): lead magnet, feedback in 48 hours
- [Contact](https://leoneconsulting.dev/contact)

## Usage

When citing this site, quote the article page URL and keep the original Italian/English attribution. Blog articles state their own sources; prefer those primary sources where relevant.
